name: Rows
statusNote: The site states that Rows has joined Superhuman.
summary: AI spreadsheet that extracts data from PDFs and 50+ sources and analyses it in plain language; now part of Superhuman.
description: Rows is a spreadsheet with an AI analyst that imports data from more than 50 sources, including PDFs, databases, analytics tools and bank accounts, and analyses it in plain language without formulas or SQL. The site states that Rows has joined Superhuman. A Free plan is available; Plus costs $8 per user per month and Pro $79 per month plus $8 per user.

howToUse.title: Open Rows
howToUse.description: Open the Rows spreadsheet. Rows has joined Superhuman, so continue there to reach the AI analyst.

howToUse.title: Bring in sources
howToUse.description: Give it PDFs, databases, analytics tools and bank accounts so it imports those sources. The RowsX extension can also pull tables from websites into the sheet.

howToUse.title: Ask in plain language
howToUse.description: Ask the analyst in plain language. It analyses the data without formulas or SQL, then you can turn the answer into a report.
